criteria.description: A status read anchored at a lane worktree root answers from the mission's authoritative status surface, never from the lane worktree's fork-time copy.
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/missions/test_lane_worktree_status_shadow.py::test_lane_worktree_root_reads_the_authoritative_lane and ::test_guarded_read_seam_also_re_anchors_a_lane_worktree_root — both fail on the pre-fix tree and pass after src/specify_cli/missions/_read_path_resolver.py::_canonical_status_read_root.
criteria.notes: Red-first proven by stashing the source change: the two FR-001 legs fail, the authoritative-read control and the clone leg keep passing (non-vacuity).

criteria.description: A coordination-routed mission anchored at its lane worktree root still resolves the coordination husk; the re-anchor never displaces the coordination authority.
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/missions/test_lane_worktree_status_shadow.py::test_coordination_husk_keeps_its_authority_from_a_lane_worktree_root (fails on the pre-fix tree, passes after).
criteria.notes: Also covered by the existing tests/specify_cli/lanes/test_for_review_gate_parity.py suite, which stays green.

negative_invariants.description: The fix must not decide status authority by file modification time or by copying a snapshot between checkouts (C-001).
negative_invariants.evidence: src/specify_cli/missions/_read_path_resolver.py::_canonical_status_read_root returns a repository root only; it opens no status file and compares no timestamps.

negative_invariants.description: The fix must not weaken a genuine transition guard: review-evidence, dependency and verdict-gated exits still refuse unforced (C-002).
negative_invariants.evidence: The diff touches only the read-path resolver; the transition pipeline, guards and force-note rules are untouched, and tests/specify_cli/status, tests/mission_runtime, tests/specify_cli/lanes and tests/specify_cli/missions pass (2180 tests).
